item.title: Designs Direct Recalls Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps, Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
item.company: Sold At: HomeGoods retail stores from June 2025 through July 2026 for between $79 and $89.
item.brand: Sold At: HomeGoods retail stores from June 2025 through July 2026 for between $79 and $89.
item.product: Designs Direct Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps
item.summary: This recall involves the Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps, model 7927-OZ and model 7927-OZ1. The lamps measure about 63-inches tall and have three six-inch diameter glass globe lampshades. The lamps are sold in multicolor and cream variants. Lamps with model number 7927-OZ (associated with HomeGoods style numbers 190734 and 211918) are gold with multi-colored lampshades. Lamps with model number 7927-OZ1 (associated with HomeGoods style numbers 192249, 208605, and 213058) are gold with cream lampshades. The model number is located on a sticker on the underside of the base of the lamp. The HomeGoods style numbers are located on the original price hangtag.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Designs Direct Cupcakes and Cashmere Brand Three-Light Floor Lamps.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled lamp immediately, turn it off, and unplug it. Consumers will be asked to cut the cord and provide a photograph of the destroyed lamp, following the instructions at https://www.designsdirectllc.com/recalls/. Designs Direct will issue a full refund to consumers within 15 days of receipt of the photo proof of destruction.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
